The invention relates to compositions, methods, and kits for maintaining hematopoietic stem cells and/or hematopoietic progenitor cells in culture. In particular, dermatopontin (DPT), or a functional fragment or derivative of DPT that retains hematopoietic cell-supporting activity, is incorporated into a culture medium to promote the survival and maintenance of these cells under ex vivo or in vitro conditions.

The culture medium may contain DPT as the principal cell-supporting component or may combine DPT with one or more additional ingredients commonly used for hematopoietic cell culture. Such ingredients may include serum or a serum replacement, reducing agents, antibiotics, nutrients, buffering agents, and cytokines or growth factors. The selection and concentration of these components may be adjusted according to the type of hematopoietic stem or progenitor cell being maintained and the intended culture period or downstream application.

The invention also provides methods in which a population containing hematopoietic stem cells and/or progenitor cells is contacted with a DPT-containing medium and cultured under suitable conditions. These methods may be used to preserve cell viability and hematopoietic potential while limiting unwanted loss or differentiation during culture. The cells may be obtained from any suitable hematopoietic source and may subsequently be used for research, screening, cell processing, or other biomedical applications.

Further provided are culture media and kits comprising DPT or a functional DPT fragment. A kit may include DPT as a ready-to-use solution, as part of a complete medium, or as a separate component to be added to a basal medium. It may additionally contain serum replacements, reducing agents, antibiotics, cytokines, or other culture supplements, together with instructions for preparing the medium and maintaining hematopoietic cells.

Accordingly, DPT-based culture systems provide a useful and adaptable platform for supporting hematopoietic stem and progenitor cells outside the body. The compositions, methods, and kits can facilitate hematopoietic cell research and may support applications involving cell maintenance, experimental manipulation, analysis, and development of hematopoietic cell-based technologies.

## Exemplary Patent-Style Disclosure

### Title

**Compositions and Methods for Culturing Hematopoietic Stem and Progenitor Cells Using Dermatopontin**

### Abstract

The present disclosure relates to methods, compositions, and kits for ex vivo culture of hematopoietic stem and progenitor cells. In certain embodiments, a population of hematopoietic stem and/or progenitor cells is contacted with dermatopontin (DPT), or a biologically active variant or fragment thereof, under culture conditions sufficient to maintain, expand, enhance survival of, or modulate differentiation of the cells. Also provided are culture media comprising DPT and kits comprising DPT together with one or more optional culture supplements.

### Exemplary Claims

1. **A method of culturing hematopoietic stem and progenitor cells, the method comprising:**  
   contacting a population comprising hematopoietic stem cells, hematopoietic progenitor cells, or a combination thereof with dermatopontin (DPT) in a culture medium; and  
   maintaining the population under ex vivo culture conditions for a period sufficient to maintain, expand, enhance survival of, or modulate differentiation of at least a portion of the hematopoietic stem or progenitor cells.

2. The method of claim 1, wherein the DPT comprises recombinant DPT, purified DPT, naturally derived DPT, or a biologically active variant or fragment thereof.

3. The method of claim 1 or claim 2, wherein the hematopoietic stem or progenitor cells are human cells.

4. The method of any preceding claim, wherein the population is obtained from bone marrow, peripheral blood, mobilized peripheral blood, umbilical cord blood, placental tissue or blood, fetal liver, or a combination thereof.

5. The method of any preceding claim, wherein the population comprises CD34-positive cells, CD38-negative or low cells, CD90-positive cells, CD45RA-negative cells, CD49f-positive cells, lineage-marker-negative cells, or a combination thereof.

6. The method of any preceding claim, wherein the DPT is present in the culture medium at an amount effective to increase cell viability, stem-cell maintenance, clonogenic capacity, self-renewal, engraftment potential, or expansion relative to a corresponding culture lacking DPT.

7. The method of any preceding claim, wherein the culture medium further comprises one or more culture supplements selected from the group consisting of cytokines, chemokines, growth factors, hormones, serum, serum replacements, albumin, lipids, amino acids, vitamins, minerals, antioxidants, extracellular-matrix components, adhesion molecules, antibiotics, and small-molecule modulators.

8. The method of claim 7, wherein the one or more culture supplements comprise stem cell factor, thrombopoietin, FMS-like tyrosine kinase 3 ligand, interleukin-3, interleukin-6, interleukin-7, interleukin-11, granulocyte colony-stimulating factor, granulocyte-macrophage colony-stimulating factor, erythropoietin, insulin-like growth factor, or a combination thereof.

9. The method of any preceding claim, wherein the cells are cultured in a serum-free, xeno-free, or chemically defined medium.

10. The method of any preceding claim, wherein DPT is soluble in the culture medium, immobilized on a culture substrate, associated with a scaffold or matrix, or presented by a support material.

11. The method of any preceding claim, further comprising collecting the cultured cells for research, screening, cell manufacturing, transplantation, regenerative medicine, or therapeutic use.

12. **A culture medium for hematopoietic stem and progenitor cells, the culture medium comprising:**  
    (a) a basal cell-culture medium; and  
    (b) DPT in an amount effective to maintain, expand, enhance survival of, or modulate differentiation of hematopoietic stem cells, hematopoietic progenitor cells, or a combination thereof.

13. The culture medium of claim 12, further comprising one or more cytokines, chemokines, growth factors, hormones, serum replacements, extracellular-matrix components, nutrients, antibiotics, or small-molecule modulators.

14. The culture medium of claim 12 or claim 13, wherein the medium is sterile, serum-free, xeno-free, chemically defined, or provided as a concentrate.

15. **A cell-culture composition comprising:**  
    a population of hematopoietic stem cells, hematopoietic progenitor cells, or a combination thereof;  
    DPT; and  
    a physiologically compatible culture medium.

16. **A kit for culturing hematopoietic stem and progenitor cells, the kit comprising:**  
    (a) DPT in a container; and  
    (b) instructions for contacting hematopoietic stem cells, hematopoietic progenitor cells, or a combination thereof with the DPT under ex vivo culture conditions.

17. The kit of claim 16, further comprising a basal culture medium or a medium concentrate.

18. The kit of claim 16 or claim 17, further comprising one or more culture supplements selected from cytokines, chemokines, growth factors, hormones, serum replacements, albumin, lipids, amino acids, vitamins, minerals, antioxidants, extracellular-matrix components, antibiotics, and small-molecule modulators.

19. The kit of any one of claims 16–18, wherein the DPT and the one or more culture supplements are provided in separate containers or as a premixed formulation.

20. The kit of any one of claims 16–19, further comprising one or more culture vessels, coated culture substrates, scaffolds, buffers, cell-selection reagents, cryopreservation reagents, or viability-assay reagents.

21. **Use of DPT for the ex vivo culture of hematopoietic stem cells, hematopoietic progenitor cells, or a combination thereof.**

22. **DPT for use in preparing a population of cultured hematopoietic stem or progenitor cells for administration to a subject.**

# Invention Disclosure

## Title

**DPT for the In Vitro Maintenance of Hematopoietic Stem and/or Progenitor Cells**

## Technical Field

The present disclosure relates to hematopoietic cell culture. More particularly, the disclosure relates to the use of DPT for maintaining hematopoietic stem cells and/or hematopoietic progenitor cells in vitro, methods of culturing such cells in the presence of DPT, cell culture media supplemented with DPT, and kits comprising DPT for use in hematopoietic cell culture.

## Background

Hematopoietic stem cells and hematopoietic progenitor cells, collectively referred to herein as “HSPCs,” have applications in basic research, drug screening, disease modeling, gene editing, cell therapy, transplantation, and regenerative medicine. During ex vivo or in vitro culture, HSPCs may undergo differentiation, loss of self-renewal capacity, loss of engraftment potential, reduced viability, or changes in phenotype and function. Accordingly, there remains a need for compositions and culture methods that maintain HSPCs in an undifferentiated, viable, and/or functionally competent state.

The inventors have determined that DPT supports maintenance of HSPCs under in vitro culture conditions. DPT can therefore be incorporated into HSPC culture workflows to preserve, sustain, or increase one or more stem- or progenitor-cell properties.

## Summary of the Invention

In one aspect, the disclosure provides the use of DPT for maintaining hematopoietic stem cells and/or hematopoietic progenitor cells in vitro.

In another aspect, the disclosure provides a method of culturing HSPCs, the method comprising contacting the cells with a culture medium containing an effective amount of DPT and maintaining the cells under in vitro culture conditions.

In another aspect, the disclosure provides a supplemented cell culture medium comprising a basal cell culture medium and DPT in an amount effective to support maintenance of HSPCs.

In a further aspect, the disclosure provides a kit comprising DPT and one or more additional components for culturing HSPCs, optionally together with instructions for using DPT to maintain HSPCs in vitro.

The disclosed uses, methods, media, and kits may support one or more of HSPC survival, viability, proliferation, self-renewal, maintenance of an undifferentiated phenotype, preservation of multipotency, clonogenicity, repopulating activity, or engraftment potential. In certain embodiments, DPT reduces spontaneous or culture-induced differentiation of HSPCs.

## Definitions

As used herein, **“DPT”** means the compound, molecule, agent, or composition designated DPT, including pharmaceutically or biologically acceptable salts, solvates, hydrates, stereoisomers, isotopologues, crystalline forms, amorphous forms, prodrugs, active metabolites, derivatives, and functional analogues thereof, where applicable. The precise chemical identity and structure of DPT may be inserted into this disclosure as **[chemical name, structure, registry number, and/or internal compound identifier]**.

As used herein, a **“hematopoietic stem cell”** or **“HSC”** is a cell capable of self-renewal and differentiation into one or more hematopoietic lineages. HSCs include long-term HSCs, short-term HSCs, primitive HSCs, and cells enriched for an HSC phenotype or function.

As used herein, a **“hematopoietic progenitor cell”** or **“HPC”** is a hematopoietic precursor having the capacity to differentiate into one or more hematopoietic lineages. HPCs include multipotent progenitors and lineage-restricted progenitors, including myeloid, lymphoid, erythroid, megakaryocytic, granulocytic, and monocytic progenitors.

The term **“HSPC”** encompasses an HSC, an HPC, or a population comprising HSCs and/or HPCs.

As used herein, **“maintenance”** includes preserving, sustaining, or improving at least one property of an HSPC relative to an appropriate control cultured without DPT. Such a property may include viability, cell number, recovery, proliferation, self-renewal, an undifferentiated phenotype, expression of one or more HSPC-associated markers, reduced expression of one or more differentiation-associated markers, multipotency, clonogenic potential, long-term culture-initiating activity, repopulating activity, or engraftment capacity. Maintenance does not require the absolute prevention of differentiation or cell loss.

An **“effective amount”** of DPT is an amount that produces a measurable improvement in at least one HSPC maintenance parameter relative to an otherwise comparable culture lacking DPT.

## Detailed Description

### 1. Cells

The HSPCs may be mammalian cells, including human, non-human primate, murine, rat, canine, feline, porcine, equine, ovine, or bovine cells. In preferred embodiments, the cells are human HSPCs.

The cells may be obtained from bone marrow, peripheral blood, mobilized peripheral blood, umbilical cord blood, placental blood or tissue, fetal liver, spleen, or another hematopoietic tissue. The cells may alternatively be generated from pluripotent stem cells, including embryonic stem cells or induced pluripotent stem cells.

The cultured population may be unfractionated or enriched, isolated, or sorted for one or more HSPC-associated markers. In human embodiments, exemplary populations include CD34-positive cells, CD34-positive/CD38-negative cells, CD34-positive/CD90-positive cells, CD34-positive/CD45RA-negative cells, and combinations thereof. Marker identity is not limiting, and HSPCs may additionally or alternatively be identified by functional assays.

### 2. Use of DPT

DPT may be used to maintain HSPCs before, during, or after a manipulation. Exemplary manipulations include:

- isolation, enrichment, or sorting;
- cryopreservation or thawing;
- expansion;
- viral or non-viral transduction;
- gene editing;
- nucleic acid, protein, or ribonucleoprotein delivery;
- drug or toxicity screening;
- differentiation assays;
- colony-forming assays;
- transplantation preparation; and
- manufacture of an HSPC-based therapeutic product.

DPT may be added at the initiation of culture, before the initiation of culture, after an initial culture period, or at multiple time points. DPT may be present continuously or intermittently. It may be replenished during medium exchange or supplied by a controlled-release or immobilized formulation.

DPT may be used alone or in combination with one or more cytokines, growth factors, small molecules, extracellular-matrix components, lipids, hormones, nutrients, antioxidants, or other HSPC-supporting agents.

### 3. Method of Culture

A representative method comprises:

1. providing a population comprising HSPCs;
2. providing a cell culture medium;
3. adding DPT to the culture medium before, during, or after contact with the HSPCs;
4. culturing the HSPCs in contact with an effective amount of DPT; and
5. optionally recovering, analyzing, expanding, differentiating, cryopreserving, genetically modifying, formulating, or administering the cultured cells.

Culture may be performed in suspension, on an adherent substrate, in a three-dimensional matrix, in a bioreactor, or in a microfluidic system. The culture system may be static or perfused and may be conducted under normoxic, hypoxic, or controlled-oxygen conditions.

The cells may be cultured for any period sufficient to obtain a desired maintenance effect, including hours, days, or weeks. The effective concentration and exposure period may be determined by routine dose-response and time-course testing using a maintenance parameter described herein.

In certain embodiments, HSPCs cultured with DPT exhibit, relative to a matched DPT-free control:

- increased viability or recovery;
- an increased number or proportion of HSPCs;
- increased retention of one or more stem- or progenitor-cell markers;
- reduced acquisition of lineage-differentiation markers;
- increased colony-forming activity;
- increased multilineage potential;
- increased self-renewal or serial replating capacity; and/or
- increased short-term or long-term repopulating activity.

### 4. Supplemented Cell Culture Medium

The disclosed medium comprises:

- a basal cell culture medium; and
- DPT at an effective concentration.

The basal medium may be a defined, semi-defined, or serum-containing medium suitable for HSPC culture. In certain embodiments, the medium is serum-free, xeno-free, chemically defined, or suitable for clinical or good-manufacturing-practice use.

The medium may further comprise one or more cytokines or growth factors, including stem cell factor, thrombopoietin, FLT3 ligand, interleukin-3, interleukin-6, interleukin-7, granulocyte colony-stimulating factor, granulocyte-macrophage colony-stimulating factor, erythropoietin, or combinations thereof.

The medium may further comprise one or more of amino acids, vitamins, inorganic salts, glucose or another energy source, lipids, albumin or an albumin substitute, insulin, transferrin, selenium, antioxidants, buffering agents, antibiotics, extracellular-matrix components, and additional small molecules.

DPT may be supplied in the medium as a dissolved component, suspension, emulsion, encapsulated composition, controlled-release composition, or surface-associated component. The supplemented medium may be provided as a ready-to-use liquid, a concentrate, a frozen composition, or a dry formulation for reconstitution.

### 5. Kit

A kit according to the disclosure comprises DPT and optionally one or more of:

- a basal culture medium or medium concentrate;
- one or more cytokines or growth factors;
- a diluent or reconstitution buffer;
- a culture vessel, plate, flask, bag, cartridge, or bioreactor component;
- a coating or extracellular-matrix reagent;
- an HSPC isolation or enrichment reagent;
- a cryopreservation or thawing reagent;
- a viability, phenotype, differentiation, or functional assay reagent;
- a transduction or gene-editing reagent; and
- written or electronic instructions for maintaining HSPCs in vitro using DPT.

DPT may be packaged separately from the other components or premixed with one or more components. It may be provided in single-use or multi-use containers and may be supplied as a liquid, concentrate, lyophilizate, powder, tablet, or other reconstitutable form.

## Exemplary Experimental Evaluation

The maintenance effect of DPT may be demonstrated by culturing equivalent HSPC populations in matched media with and without DPT. Endpoints may include:

- viable cell count and percentage viability;
- flow-cytometric quantification of HSPC-associated and differentiation-associated markers;
- apoptosis or cell-cycle analysis;
- colony-forming unit assays;
- multilineage differentiation assays;
- long-term culture-initiating cell assays;
- serial replating assays;
- transcriptomic, epigenetic, proteomic, or metabolic analysis; and
- in vivo homing, engraftment, or multilineage repopulation assays.

Appropriate vehicle controls and dose-response testing may be included. A statistically or biologically meaningful improvement in at least one maintenance endpoint supports selection of an effective DPT concentration.

## Exemplary Claims

1. **A method of maintaining hematopoietic stem cells and/or hematopoietic progenitor cells in vitro, comprising culturing the cells in a cell culture medium comprising an effective amount of DPT.**

2. The method of claim 1, wherein DPT preserves or increases at least one of cell viability, cell recovery, self-renewal, an undifferentiated phenotype, multipotency, clonogenicity, repopulating activity, or engraftment potential.

3. The method of claim 1 or 2, wherein DPT reduces differentiation of the hematopoietic stem cells and/or hematopoietic progenitor cells.

4. The method of any preceding claim, wherein the cells are human cells.

5. The method of any preceding claim, wherein the cells comprise CD34-positive cells.

6. The method of any preceding claim, wherein the cells are obtained from bone marrow, peripheral blood, mobilized peripheral blood, umbilical cord blood, placental tissue, or fetal liver, or are derived from pluripotent stem cells.

7. The method of any preceding claim, wherein the medium is serum-free, xeno-free, and/or chemically defined.

8. The method of any preceding claim, wherein the medium further comprises one or more cytokines or growth factors selected from stem cell factor, thrombopoietin, FLT3 ligand, interleukin-3, interleukin-6, interleukin-7, granulocyte colony-stimulating factor, granulocyte-macrophage colony-stimulating factor, and erythropoietin.

9. The method of any preceding claim, further comprising genetically modifying the cells before, during, or after culture with DPT.

10. The method of any preceding claim, further comprising recovering, cryopreserving, differentiating, assaying, formulating, or administering the cultured cells.

11. **A cell culture medium comprising a basal cell culture medium and an amount of DPT effective to maintain hematopoietic stem cells and/or hematopoietic progenitor cells in vitro.**

12. The medium of claim 11, wherein the medium is serum-free, xeno-free, chemically defined, and/or suitable for good-manufacturing-practice use.

13. The medium of claim 11 or 12, further comprising at least one HSPC-supporting cytokine or growth factor.

14. **A kit comprising DPT and instructions for using DPT to maintain hematopoietic stem cells and/or hematopoietic progenitor cells in vitro.**

15. The kit of claim 14, further comprising a basal culture medium, a medium concentrate, a cytokine, a growth factor, a diluent, a culture vessel, an HSPC isolation reagent, or an assay reagent.

16. **Use of DPT for maintaining hematopoietic stem cells and/or hematopoietic progenitor cells in vitro.**

17. DPT for use in the ex vivo preparation of a hematopoietic stem- and/or progenitor-cell composition for transplantation or cell therapy, wherein the cells are cultured in contact with DPT before administration.

## Abstract

The disclosure provides the use of DPT for maintaining hematopoietic stem cells and/or hematopoietic progenitor cells in vitro. HSPCs are cultured in a medium containing an effective amount of DPT, thereby preserving or improving one or more properties selected from viability, recovery, self-renewal, an undifferentiated phenotype, multipotency, clonogenicity, repopulating activity, and engraftment potential. Also provided are supplemented culture media comprising DPT and kits containing DPT and instructions or additional reagents for HSPC culture.
